locality_record.name: DLF Phase 4 (Sector 28), Gurugram
locality_record.raw_civic_notes: Established gated residential hub adjacent to Galleria Market and IFFCO Chowk/MG Road Yellow Line Metro stations. Top-tier schools (The Shri Ram School Aravali, Ridge Valley) and tertiary hospitals (Fortis, Max) are within 1.5-2.5 km. GMDA canal water supply is stable, though internal colony roads near Hamilton Court experience localized waterlogging during peak July-August monsoon downpours. Most societies have 100% DG backup for minor DHBVN feeder trips.
